description: Regolith filter that selects a manifest variant per profile and resolves its extends chain.

manifestPath.description: Manifest to resolve, relative to the temp workspace ('packs/' prefix is stripped if present). Pass an array to resolve one per pack. The result is always written as manifest.json beside the source, and every other manifest.*.json in BP/ and RP/ is deleted so variants never ship.

pretty.description: How generated JSON is laid out. Absent or false writes it minified. An object lays it out: `indent` is "tab" or "space" (spaces when omitted), `size` the characters per level (2 for spaces, 1 for tabs when omitted).
